Official document (PDF) · Meeting record S/PV.3002

Resolution 703 (1991) of 9 August 1991

The Security Council,

Having examined the application of the Federated States of Micronesia for admission to the United Nations, 203

Recommends to the General Assembly that the Federated States of Micronesia be admitted to membership in the United

Nations. Adopted without a vote at the 3002nd meeting.
